displayName: Job generate-site: failed or not run

documentation.content: The job that generates the public web every night failed, or has not finished well for 25 hours, so the pages may show withdrawn dilemmas or miss new ones. Open Cloud Run, Jobs, `generate-site`, and its last execution's logs; if there is none, open Cloud Scheduler, `generate-site`, and its last attempt (a 403 means the scheduler account may not run the job). The service keeps answering with the last site generated. Run it again with `gcloud run jobs execute generate-site --region europe-southwest1`.

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.label.job_name="generate-site" AND metric.label.result="failed"

conditions.displayName: No execution finished well in 25 hours

conditionAbsent.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.label.job_name="generate-site" AND metric.label.result="succeeded"
